mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.8% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which may trigger a central bank response and reduce real interest rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.8% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the likelihood of monetary policy accommodation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between the interaction signal and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a policy response and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO remains below 104.0 for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 237.0 over a 2-month window signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain or tighten monetary policy, which increases real yields and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 237.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDP (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand and housing market momentum, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to generate positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between the interaction signal and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month signals strong labor market demand, which may lead to wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200k in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.8% signals a dual shock of supply contraction and labor market weakness, which increases the likelihood of aggressive policy intervention and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO < 104.0 and UNRATE > 5.8% fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between the interaction signal and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
